body: Reviewed calendar build transform reuses geometry within each layout pass, defers unused formatted details and avoids accumulated chunk-array copies. With 1,000 cards, five-sample warm medians improve from 190 to 160 ms locally and from 1064 to 972 ms under network/CPU emulation. Complete dense-layout popups, resize recovery and observed versions are covered. A reproduced session-revocation exception is fixed by retaining the authenticated timezone for locked drafts. Initial and integrated full gates and affected browser checks pass; the obsolete Focus comments test selector was corrected. The combined release at 16a6935 is rebuilt/restarted and all 33 assets at the existing HTTPS address are verified. Evidence: progress/2026-09-30-calendar-rendering.md and progress/2026-09-30-session-clock-retention.md. Physical-device acceptance, refresh/rendering costs and the durable-write target remain open; scope and card acceptance are unchanged.

metadata.summary: Calendar rendering optimized and combined release verified
